arguments.sql:
SELECT f."NSLP Provision Status", s.Magnet, s.State, COUNT(*) AS schools, COUNT(t.cds) AS sat_records
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
GROUP BY f."NSLP Provision Status", s.Magnet, s.State;

SELECT

    COALESCE(SUM(t.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.County
LIMIT 1000
